catalog.name: trellis.auth.flow.duration
catalog.observation: Keep accepted per-operation phase combinations; never sum total with its child phases.

catalog.name: trellis.auth.callout.duration
catalog.observation: Keep accepted admission boundaries and outcomes.

catalog.name: trellis.contract.analysis.duration
catalog.observation: Existing immutable-evidence computation and queue boundaries.

catalog.name: trellis.contract.cache.requests
catalog.observation: Exactly one final lookup role per call; preserve accepted atomic reservation.

catalog.name: trellis.connect.duration
catalog.observation: One total for each public connect attempt through usable installation, not socket creation.

catalog.name: trellis.auth.approval_resolution.duration

attributes.existing_contract: retain existing static operation/phase/outcome keys; source ledger S02

catalog.observation: Declared helper instrument with no production emitting call; reserved for an approval lifecycle that does not exist yet. Not a production SLI and no samples are fabricated for it.

catalog.name: trellis.admin.workflow.duration

attributes.existing_contract: retain existing static operation/phase/outcome keys; source ledger S02

catalog.observation: Emitted only by trellis-test administration automation; production administrative requests use their actual request/CLI observation boundaries. Retained as helper coverage, not a production SLI.

catalog.name: trellis.errors

attributes.existing_contract: retain existing bounded classification; do not add raw exception text or IDs

catalog.owner: Existing TS error adapter and matched Rust boundaries
catalog.observation: Diagnostic error occurrences, not the SLO request denominator. Do not count one exception at every rethrow.

catalog.name: trellis.rpc.client.duration
catalog.observation: Exactly one logical RPC, including retries, serialization and final decode.

catalog.name: trellis.rpc.client.attempts
catalog.observation: One actual request transport attempt; no event for backoff alone.

catalog.name: trellis.rpc.server.duration
catalog.owner: Rust request loop / TS RPC dispatcher
catalog.observation: Receive through validation, handler and response handoff. Only unary RPC, not live/operation lifetime.

catalog.name: trellis.rpc.server.inflight
catalog.observation: Increment on request admission to owned work; decrement exactly once on completion/cancellation.

catalog.name: trellis.http.server.duration
catalog.observation: One HTTP response through response-header construction, not streaming asset-body completion.

catalog.name: trellis.connection.count
catalog.observation: Current local connection counts, not historical attempts. Browser count is browser telemetry only.
catalog.aggregation: sum across processes; each connection occupies one state

catalog.name: trellis.connection.transitions
catalog.observation: At completed state changes only. Never per poll or reconnect retry log.

catalog.name: trellis.auth.refresh.attempts
catalog.observation: One actual credential-bound HTTP refresh; coverage-only reconciliation is not a refresh.

catalog.name: trellis.auth.verification.duration
catalog.observation: One outer verification result; cache-only and cold requests both measured.

catalog.name: trellis.auth.coverage.count
catalog.observation: Aggregate live retained entries; do not add context digest labels.

catalog.name: trellis.auth.post_commit.duration
catalog.observation: Claimed action execution through persisted acknowledge/failure result.

catalog.name: trellis.auth.post_commit.pending
catalog.observation: COUNT(*) of outstanding auth_post_commit_actions; includes blocked/retry/inflight.
catalog.aggregation: sum only across active platform owners

catalog.name: trellis.auth.post_commit.oldest.age
catalog.observation: max(0, now_ms-MIN(created_at))/1000; zero only on a successful empty query.

catalog.name: trellis.job.submission.duration
catalog.observation: One logical submission through its real durable publication/admission outcome.

catalog.name: trellis.job.attempt.duration
catalog.observation: One local attempt through lifecycle disposition. A stale completion is lease_lost, not completed.

catalog.name: trellis.job.lease.events
catalog.observation: Completed lease action, not another lease or heartbeat loop.

catalog.name: trellis.jobs.ready
catalog.observation: Pending rows with a nonfuture queue-age anchor and unexpired/null deadline; Retry rows are separately reported, not assumed ready.

catalog.name: trellis.jobs.oldest_ready.age
catalog.observation: Age of oldest Pending row satisfying the exact ready predicate; successful empty=0; error retains stale snapshot.

catalog.name: trellis.jobs.dead
catalog.observation: Undismissed dead jobs in current projection, not cumulative attempts.

catalog.name: trellis.jobs.worker.registrations
catalog.observation: Fresh queue-worker registrations under WORKER_PRESENCE_FRESH_FOR; not distinct physical machines.

catalog.name: trellis.jobs.waiting_retry
catalog.observation: COUNT(*) WHERE state='retry'; no assertion that delivery is currently eligible.
catalog.aggregation: one active Jobs owner per cluster

catalog.name: trellis.operation.execution.duration
catalog.observation: One acquired execution lifetime; does not create a lifetime-long OTel span.

catalog.name: trellis.operation.active
catalog.observation: Live locally owned executions; decrement once when ownership/cancellation/task ends.

catalog.name: trellis.operation.ownership.events
catalog.observation: An observed ownership result; no change to CAS or owner epoch.

catalog.name: trellis.event.publish.duration
catalog.observation: Durable ends at publish ACK; ephemeral ends at existing transport handoff.

catalog.name: trellis.event.process.duration
catalog.observation: One handler-delivery attempt; includes its existing verification/disposition boundary.

catalog.name: trellis.delivery.dispositions
catalog.observation: Observed actual disposition handoff/ACK; not guaranteed business exactly-once accounting.

catalog.name: trellis.consumer.pending
catalog.observation: Sum num_pending over declared existing durable Consumers; internal projector consumers excluded.

catalog.name: trellis.consumer.ack_pending
catalog.observation: Sum num_ack_pending; distinct from pending.

catalog.name: trellis.consumer.missing
catalog.observation: Authoritatively declared Consumer with actual NotFound. IO error is not missing or zero.

catalog.name: trellis.consumer.progress.age
catalog.observation: Maximum local observation time since ack-floor progress while outstanding work exists. Successful idle=0.

catalog.name: trellis.dlq.entries
catalog.observation: Current unresolved dead-letter states; replay history is not another live entry.

catalog.name: trellis.dlq.transitions
catalog.observation: Record once per local authoritative transition operation; rebuilding projector does not re-emit business transitions.

catalog.name: trellis.projection.duration
catalog.observation: One projection apply/batch through SQL result and message disposition; annotate batch size on span only.

catalog.name: trellis.projection.pending
catalog.observation: Broker pending + ack-pending for that active projection consumer, not sequence subtraction.

catalog.name: trellis.projection.progress.age
catalog.observation: Time since observed durable checkpoint/ack-floor advance while backlog exists; idle=0.

catalog.name: trellis.storage.duration
catalog.observation: Only emitted phase combinations specified by the plan; do not count nested wrapper totals twice.

catalog.name: trellis.transfer.duration
catalog.observation: One transfer, through actual digest/commit completion; no per-chunk spans.

catalog.name: trellis.transfer.wire.bytes
catalog.observation: Actual transmitted/received payload bytes, including retries; not business unique object size.

catalog.name: trellis.live.sessions
catalog.owner: Live observation endpoint record (Rust and TypeScript)
catalog.observation: Move exactly one unit between phases; remove at actual local cleanup completion. Retained cleanup stays closing. Never export closed or tombstone series.

catalog.name: trellis.live.ends
catalog.observation: Exactly once at the local terminal commit, including admitted prepared sessions that expire or are cancelled. A pending normal END is not yet a consumer terminal.

catalog.name: trellis.live.handshake.duration
catalog.observation: First activation initiation through committed ACTIVE or activation failure. Recorded once; retries do not restart it, and how long an unused prepared handle was held is not included.

catalog.name: trellis.live.buffered.bytes
catalog.observation: Actual retained serialized DATA/source-ingress payload bytes. The charge transfers from raw admission to decoded/staged ownership and releases on handoff, drop or fence. Scalar outstanding-credit costs are not retained bytes and must not be added here; this is not total heap or RSS.

catalog.name: trellis.live.frames
catalog.observation: Count actual admitted outgoing and verified incoming live messages once per wire attempt; retry traffic is traffic. Non-DATA protocol messages are control. Rejected input is not admitted receive traffic.

catalog.name: trellis.live.rejections
catalog.observation: Fixed rejection categories only. Unauthenticated and unsafe requests are dropped without reflection and without an arbitrary error-text dimension.

catalog.name: trellis.live.cleanup.pending
catalog.observation: Increment once when owned cleanup exceeds the shared grace; decrement only at actual later settlement. Removing the live record from normal routing never clears it.

catalog.name: trellis.resource.bindings
catalog.observation: Aggregate existing materialized binding states; metric never determines readiness.

catalog.name: trellis.runtime.component.ready
catalog.observation: Existing component startup/owner/task health predicate; 0/1, no new liveness definition.

catalog.name: trellis.runtime.component.observed.time
catalog.observation: Unix seconds of last successful current-state observation, not last request.

catalog.name: trellis.runtime.lease.events
catalog.observation: Observe existing ownership actions only; losing ownership retains existing fatal behavior.

catalog.name: trellis.snapshot.observed.time
catalog.observation: Unix seconds for last successful whole snapshot; initial 0 means unknown, error does not advance.

catalog.name: trellis.snapshot.errors
catalog.observation: One failed polling attempt; snapshot remains last known with stale timestamp.

catalog.name: trellis.cli.duration
catalog.observation: One command; completion/version/help do not start exporters.

catalog.name: trellis.browser.navigation.duration
catalog.observation: Actual shell/authorized-ready milestones; no full URL and no comparison threshold.

catalog.name: trellis.browser.errors
catalog.observation: Sanitized local category only; untrusted browser metrics excluded from server SLOs.

catalog.name: trellis.telemetry.route_overflow
catalog.observation: Count registration mapped to _other beyond 128 per family, without echoing rejected label.
